bytes.direct_reference_state: 2 J q^2 float64 sums + count + d weights
bytes.note: ring topology is immutable index metadata, reported separately

complexity.flops: not measured; not inferred from wall time or parameter counts

orders.factorization: dense Cholesky O(M^3) per routed input; pilot factor O(M^3) per parameter state
orders.fixed_route_update: O(M^3 + 2B 2 M^2): one shared factor for all directions and adjoints
orders.gradient: O(n sum_l J n_l n_(l+1)) block contractions; retraction O(sum_l J n_l n_(l+1)^2)
orders.hessian_assembly: dense in this implementation: O(16 M^2) per parameter state plus O(n 16 M^2) per routed batch of n inputs (dense tensordot)
orders.inference: two passes: O(M^2) pilot solve with shared factor + O(M^3) second factor and solve
orders.schur_reference: diagnostic only: O(M^3) LU solves on 8 inputs per set and checkpoint
orders.solves: O(M^2) per pilot, second and adjoint solve
orders.source_acquisition: v2 CV + refit (33 local fits) + O(J q^3) basis completion

confirmation.execution_note: source acquisition and warm-up execute once per world and are shared by every arm and branch; each standalone arm is charged them in charged_counts_per_arm_and_branch. Arm meters count adaptation only; evaluator inference, controls and Schur references are in the evaluator meter.

independent_pairs.note: B, return and evaluator draws are shared across branches; evaluator second views are generated but unused

confirmation.rss_scope: cumulative parent-process high-water RSS (Linux KiB), not per-arm memory
confirmation.scope: single process: generation, acquisition, warm-up, branches, evaluator, analysis, write

independent_pairs.note: B, return and evaluator draws are shared across branches; evaluator second views are generated but unused
